description: This bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three models—DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot)—across two evaluation metrics: Recall and F1 Score. The horizontal axis displays the two metrics, “Recall” and “F1 Score,” while the vertical axis represents the performance score, ranging from 40 to 100 on a linear scale. For each metric, three bars are grouped side-by-side, each corresponding to one model variant, as indicated by the legend: DIN-SQL (zero-shot) is light blue, TA-SQL (zero-shot) is dark blue, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) is light green. In the “Recall” group, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches 63.58, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches 71.90, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar reaches 72.29. In the “F1 Score” group, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches 75.34, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches 80.40, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar reaches 81.08. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the model names as listed in the legend. Each bar is labeled with its exact numerical value at the top. The chart does not show any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding for any specific bar.
